source_statement: Every finite real m by n matrix is assigned specified factors R:m by min(m,n),Q:min(m,n) by n with A=RQ and QQ^T=I. Wide factors literally extract the residual/transform of the fixed adjacent-Givens elimination of the transpose; tall factors are A and identity. Zero, deficient and empty shapes included. Exact-real deterministic mathematical definitions, not a computable finite-bit procedure, triangularity, stability, runtime, quantum action or cost certificate.
